title: Radio Group (shadcn/ui)
notes:
A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

Install into a project: npx shadcn@latest add radio-group

Original file: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/radio-group.tsx
